name: Dogs of War (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level antipaladin 4, bard 5, bloodlord 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, inquisitor 5, legendary ninja 4, paladin 4, ranger 4, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (a dog whistle)

EFFECT

Range close (25 feet + 5 feet/2 levels)
Effect 1d4+1 dire wolves
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You break the whistle in your hands and a call rings out summoning well trained hounds.

When you finish casting this spell you summon 1d4+1 dire wolves that follow your commands, or the commands of any allies you designate when you cast the spell. If you do not spend an action during battle to direct one of the wolves on your turn, it attacks the nearest creature that is hostile to you.

If you also expend 50 gp worth of worked leather, iron, and linens when you cast this spell you may summon the wolves with saddles and reins sufficient to serve as mounts.
